name: Praying And Reading The Bible
overview: Scripture reveals that the Word of God is both divine and life-giving, as Jesus declares in John 1:1 and John 6:63, emphasizing that His words are spirit and life. True believers, those who are of God, hear and keep His words, demonstrating their love for Christ through obedience (John 8:47; John 14:15). This intimate relationship with Christ is marked by His words abiding in the believer, resulting in answered prayer and the presence of the Father and Son dwelling within (John 14:23; John 15:7). Thus, praying and reading the Bible are inseparably linked in the life of a Christian who abides in Christ and loves Him.
